description: Save a LinkedIn post to your library by its URL. Resolves the post and stores it with source_type='saved'. Optionally pins the post into any collection you own (manual or smart — pinning into a smart collection adds it as an extra alongside the rule's matches). Costs 1 credit per call. Failed lookups don't charge.

collection_id.description: Optional collection UUID to pin the post into. Must be a collection you own — any type.

url.description: Public LinkedIn post URL. Accepts linkedin.com/posts/... permalinks and linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:... feed URLs.

name: save_post
title: Save LinkedIn Post
